EV-SUPERSEDED-AUDIT.summary: The commit only creates or repairs the superseded branch-local audit, roadmap, or generated evidence record; it is retained as provenance and is not an implementation candidate.

EV-REJECTED-REGEX-GATE.summary: The change adjusts a grep or regex symptom without establishing the compiler-owned authority required by the current architecture.

EV-REJECTED-FORMAT-SCOPE.summary: Format-scope bookkeeping is not a domain or contract implementation and must not be replayed as product remediation.

EV-MAIN-CI.summary: The current baseline already carries the CI/type-check authority needed by this semantic change; the historical commit itself is not replayed.

EV-MAIN-NATS-ACL.summary: The current NATS service authority grants auth-service the governed announcement publish subject.

EV-MAIN-AUTH-SQL.summary: The current admin users read path qualifies the auth-owned tenant relation and projects the live audit column.

EV-ROOT-ADMIN-HTTP-CONTRACT.summary: The active worktree replaces branch-local mirrors and per-route patches with the executable admin response-contract DAG, canonical pagination projection, generated frontend contracts, and route-demand equality gates.

EV-ROOT-BACKUP-ROUTE-RETIREMENT.summary: The active worktree physically removes all eleven legacy admin backup and restore routes plus the pg_dump/file-delete/cron/fake-PITR service, runtime backup entities, tenant-deprovision dependency, frontend retirement tab, dead response projections, and the 410 compatibility lifecycle. Destructive schema deletion now admits tenant erasure evidence only; historical backup migrations remain immutable history, not runtime authority.

EV-ROOT-NATS-RUNTIME-PROFILE.summary: admin-api onboarding outcomes are consumed through a byte-deterministic runtime profile compiled from the service catalog and event registry; the live handler asserts exact handler equality and subscribes the catalog-derived durable event set.

EV-ROOT-ONBOARDING-ACTIVATION.summary: Tenant activation is guarded by an exact generation-bound PostgreSQL evidence seal: the final onboarding publication, activation-proof consume, tenant transition, command receipt, and durable auth outbox write execute under owner-specific typed authorities instead of a timing-based wait/requeue loop.

EV-ROOT-ACTOR-IDENTITY.summary: Human support mutations persist the authenticated JWT actor UUID, authorless cron mutations use the single canonical system-principal UUID, and every client-provided UUID in the affected support boundary is rejected before persistence when malformed.

EV-ROOT-REPORTING-AUTHORITY.summary: The active worktree replaces schedule, dead URL, synthetic artifact, empty preview, range, and pagination patches with one compiled reporting authority graph, an execution-pinned catalog and resource cut, independently attested measurement adapters, a canonical paginated decoder, and a durable CAS artifact commit and reconciliation protocol; production measurements remain fail-closed until owner-qualified facts exist.

EV-ROOT-ROLE-VOCABULARY.summary: The active worktree makes the event-contract role vocabulary the only authored authority and projects backend validation, route contracts, and frontend labels from it under an exact-set invariant.

EV-ROOT-ANALYTICS-METRIC-AUTHORITY.summary: The active worktree replaces fabricated analytics values and route-specific compatibility shapes with a closed metric catalog, canonical catalog digest and evidence projection, nullable unavailable metrics, source-failure rejection, and one generated trend response contract.

EV-MAIN-ANALYTICS-INVOICE-STATUS.summary: The current analytics owner excludes refunded invoices from outstanding receivables by summing only pending and sent rows while projecting refunded totals separately.

EV-ROOT-CACHE-AUTHORITY.summary: The active worktree replaces snapshot and log-only cache behavior with a Redis-owned measured projection, canonical invalidation request/receipt contract, exact deletion accounting, and frontend receipt verification.

EV-ROOT-ADMIN-AUDIT-AUTHORITY.summary: The active worktree replaces audit vocabulary patches and duplicate activity writers with one typed action/write-policy/severity catalog, one generated browser/server contract surface, one SECURITY DEFINER append authority, one separately fenced retention-delete role, durable provenance for every pre-trust/imported row, and verified-request actor attribution. Runtime code cannot promote historical rows or directly INSERT, UPDATE, or DELETE audit evidence.

EV-OPEN-NATS.summary: admin-api still declares tenant-onboarding event handlers without a catalog-derived Nest NATS runtime profile; an inline bootstrap flag would repeat the drift instead of closing it.

EV-OPEN-SAGA.summary: The active tenant-provisioning workflow has not yet been proven against the branch commit's activation/ack barrier and retry semantics.

EV-OPEN-LEGAL-HOLD.summary: The messaging owner requires approverId and a governed release reason, while the active admin/frontend request shape still supplies only holdId and tenantId.

EV-OPEN-SUPPORT-OWNERSHIP.summary: Announcements, support tickets, and support messaging still have competing auth/admin ownership paths; a single owner and typed cross-service command surface have not been established.

EV-OPEN-EDGE-ROUTING.summary: The active compose/nginx surfaces are not all projected from one edge-routing authority, so replaying a branch-local config edit would preserve topology drift.

EV-OPEN-SECURITY.summary: The audited security behavior remains incomplete in the active tree: revocation, failed-auth throttling, distributed rate limits, CSRF/CORS posture, and actor attribution require root authority closure.

EV-OPEN-TELEMETRY.summary: The audited UI/API surface still contains ungrounded health, security, or operational telemetry and lacks a complete measured-or-unknown authority.

EV-OPEN-ANALYTICS.summary: The active analytics/reporting implementation has not adopted the branch commit's data-grounding behavior and still requires source-owned measurements with explicit unknown states.

EV-OPEN-CONFIG-OWNERSHIP.summary: Tenant configuration ownership is only partially moved to config-service: writes and reads do not yet form one enforced, non-fabricated authority.

EV-OPEN-CACHE-AUTHORITY.summary: The cache inspector still needs a Redis-owned measured projection and real invalidation semantics; snapshot/fake-success behavior is not accepted.

EV-OPEN-IMPERSONATION.summary: Impersonation lifecycle, consumer, revocation, audit, and metrics semantics have not been closed as one security state machine in the active tree.

EV-OPEN-GENERAL.summary: Read-only comparison found no complete equivalent in the active root architecture; the historical diff must be redesigned or independently verified before implementation.
